Plot the decomposition of community trait means

Source: R/trait_variation.R
plot.trait_flex.Rd

Draws, for each trait, the sums of squares among sites of the community mean due to species turnover, intraspecific variability, their covariation and the total, from trait_flex(). With an environmental model each bar is split into the part explained by the model and the residual part. A negative covariation (turnover and intraspecific variability moving the community mean in opposite directions) is drawn below zero. Needs the package ggplot2.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'trait_flex'
plot(x, relative = TRUE, colours = c("#0072B2", "grey80"), ...)

Arguments

x

Result of trait_flex().

relative

If TRUE (the default), sums of squares are divided by the total sum of squares of each trait, so that traits on different scales can be compared.

colours

Two colours, for the explained and the residual parts (only the first is used without a model). The default is the blue of the Okabe-Ito palette and a light grey, as in plot.nested_variance().

...

Not used.

Value

A ggplot object, which can be changed further with ggplot2 functions.

See also

trait_flex().

Other trait variation among individuals: community_index(), neighbour_metrics, nested_variance(), null_intervals(), plot.mc_trait_gradient(), plot.nested_variance(), plot.trait_rarefaction(), plot.tstats(), plot_population_traits(), population_shifts(), sample_individuals(), subsample_individuals(), trait_densities(), trait_flex(), trait_gradient(), trait_gradient_bayes(), trait_gradient_phylo(), trait_gradient_test(), trait_gradient_weights(), trait_rarefaction(), tstats(), tstats_summary()

Examples

set.seed(1)
ind <- data.frame(site = rep(paste0("s", 1:8), each = 20),
                  species = sample(c("a", "b", "c"), 160, replace = TRUE))
env <- data.frame(site = paste0("s", 1:8), moisture = 1:8)
shift <- env$moisture[match(ind$site, env$site)]
ind$height <- c(a = 10, b = 20, c = 30)[ind$species] + shift + rnorm(160)
ind$leaf <- c(a = 3, b = 2, c = 1)[ind$species] - 0.3 * shift + rnorm(160)
plot(trait_flex(ind, traits = c("height", "leaf"), formula = ~ moisture, env = env))
